allowedSlippage.description: How much the execution price is allowed to move unfavorably from the trade execution price. Uses a rational number for precision.

gasLimitEstimate.description: The maximum gas used to estimate gasCost for a hyperswap trade.

ttl.description: How long a trade is valid in seconds. After time passes hyperswap will not perform the trade, but the gas will still be sent.

maximumHops.description: For each swap, the maximum number of hops to consider. More hops will increase latency of the algorithm.

routerAddress.description: Address of the Hyperswap V2 Router contract

factoryAddress.description: Address of the Hyperswap V2 Factory contract

quoterAddress.description: Address of the Hyperswap V2 Multicall contract used for quotes
